tools.name: get_system_manifest
tools.description: [Tier 0 · meta] Return TovCore capability domains, theological scoring rules (0-10 & D-428 Bethel guard), 5 core scenarios, and tool index.

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: [Tier 0 · catalog] Search worship songs by keyword, artist, language (zh/en/ko/ja), minimum theological score, tempo, or negative exclusions.

tools.name: search_by_scripture
tools.description: [Tier 0 · catalog] Find worship songs anchored to a Bible book or scripture theme (e.g. 诗篇, Psalms, 罗马书, Romans, 约翰福音, 十字架).

tools.name: get_song_detail
tools.description: [Tier 0 · catalog] Get full song profile including R2 TOVPACK2 theological evaluation (summary, B/F/C/R scores, reasons, hits, focus Q&A, scripture refs), metadata, and canonical/Markdown URLs.

tools.name: list_popular_songs
tools.description: [Tier 0 · insights] List popular worship songs and community vote totals from D1, enriched with title/artist/score.

tools.name: plan_worship_setlist
tools.description: [Tier 0 · worship] Generate a deterministic worship setlist (opening fast -> proclamation -> response slow) honoring theological score, scripture, D-428 rules, and negativeConstraints.

tools.name: audit_setlist
tools.description: [Tier 0 · worship] Batch theological & tempo audit for 1-20 candidate songs (IDs or titles). Flags scores below threshold, D-428 Bethel hits, tempo balance, and suggests safer replacements.

tools.name: find_similar_songs
tools.description: [Tier 0 · worship] Find theologically solid alternative worship songs sharing theme, scripture, language, or tempo with a seed song (respecting D-428 guard).

tools.name: get_my_playlists
tools.description: [Tier 0 · personal] Read the authenticated user playlists (requires Bearer JWT or Personal AI Token tvc_...) to avoid repeating recently sung songs.

tools.name: propose_setlist_save
tools.description: [Tier 1 · worship] Stage a new worship setlist proposal card for 1-tap owner confirmation inside TovCore (persisted to owner inbox if authenticated; never mutates playlists directly).

tools.name: propose_playlist_patch
tools.description: [Tier 1 · worship] Stage a proposal to update/replace songs in an existing user playlist (two-phase confirmation; never mutates directly).

tools.name: propose_live_queue
tools.description: [Tier 1 · worship] Stage a Group Live / TV Cast worship queue proposal so the worship leader can tap once in TovCore to launch live projection or group sync.

tools.name: list_my_proposals
tools.description: [Tier 0 · personal] List pending/recent proposals in the authenticated user inbox (requires Bearer JWT or Personal AI Token tvc_...).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_playlists" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
